newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street stocks retrace some lost ground.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street stocks retrace some lost ground.

text.p: Wall Street stocks pulled off session lows early Monday afternoon, recovering some ground that was lost after the release of stronger-than-expected manufacturing and home-sales data.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average was down around 26 points at 7661, as the New York Stock Exchange lifted trading curbs.
The long bond was down 27/32 to yield 6.81 percent.
The Nasdaq Composite moved to positive territory, trading up around one point to 1439.
The market remained focused on the Federal Reserve policy meeting, which begins Tuesday, and manufacturing and employment data, due to be released this week.
